messages:
owen: Quick security ping for PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3245 - adding on-prem egress guard + auth changes. Need a quick review for secrets handling + KMS usage. @tanvi @jess :eyes:

owen: TL;DR: rotating service account for onprem agents, Vault dynamic creds instead of long-lived keys, added KMS envelope wrap for artifacts, new firewall egress rule to allow telemetry to metrics.redwood.local

tanvi: thanks. quick Qs: 1) where are the Vault roles defined? 2) SA scopes — anything beyond cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter?

jess: main thing: KMS key policy change in this PR grants decrypt to onprem SA. can you paste the terraform snippet? also ensure key ring location matches customer region.

owen: terraform snippet:
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member" "onprem_decrypt" {
  crypto_key_id = var.kms_key
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  member        = "serviceAccount:onprem-agent@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}
```
No long-lived JSON keys stored. Vault role defined in `infra/vault/roles.tf` as `onprem-agent-role` with ttl 8h.

morgan: add a log/audit requirement — need Cloud Audit Logs for key access retained 90d for compliance. please add to PR checklist.

owen: yep will add. Also added e2e smoke: `curl -sS https://metrics.redwood.local/health | jq .status` in scripts/test/onprem-smoke.sh

tanvi: also confirm that the egress rule only permits telemetry host and not wildcard. put rule as explicit host:port. don't allow 0.0.0.0/0

owen: confirmed, rule is `allow tcp to 10.88.200.12:443` in `k8s/network/policies/onprem-egress.yaml`.

sec-bot: Snyk scan: no high severity findings. IAM Analyzer: warning - KMS member binding detected (needs approver).

jess: I can approve if you add audit retention and tighten key location. Also add a short note in PR description about why Vault dynamic creds are sufficient for offline agent rotation.

morgan: +1 to jess, will approve after PR edit. If you want faster merge ping me when updated :thumbsup:

owen: updated PR description and added audit retention step in checklist. pushed commit 5a7c9d2.

tanvi: reviewed changes, SA scopes look minimal. :white_check_mark:

jess: approved — leaving LGTMs. :rocket:

morgan: approving now. :heavy_check_mark:

owen: thanks everyone — merging in 30m unless other concerns. :pray:

jess: heads up — onprem rollout needs a canary to 2 nodes first. file an ops ticket if you want me to coordinate.

owen: will create ops ticket after merge. done: https://go/ops/RED-4321

sec-bot: deploy-bot: merge scheduled at 2026-03-17T15:30:00Z
